knowledge.title: Financing by credit tier
knowledge.content: Phones are financed over 24 months by default. Prime: 0% APR, nothing down. Near-prime: 4.9% APR, 10% down. Subprime: 9.9% APR, 20% down. Paying in full charges the whole price today. Due today = minimum down payment; the rest is monthly.

knowledge.title: Trade-in rules
knowledge.content: Trade-in credit applies to the first phone in the cart; any leftover is reported as unapplied. A phone's value falls with age (good condition; fair and poor are lower). A phone that is still being paid off charges its remaining balance today and its old monthly installment stops. A paid-off phone owes nothing. A line's phone can be traded in once.

knowledge.title: Upgrade eligibility
knowledge.content: Sandbox rule: a line is upgrade-eligible when its phone has been owned 12+ months (half of a 24-month installment). Within 3 months of buying a phone, most of it is still owed: say what trading it in would charge today before suggesting an upgrade, and consider recommending waiting.

knowledge.title: Changing plans and adding lines
knowledge.content: A plan change charges the difference from the line's current plan; the monthly change can be negative on a downgrade. A new line is priced by its position in the household using the plan's per-line table, so each extra line costs less. All lines on an account share one plan. New lines in the cart count toward plan limits: add them before moving existing lines onto the 4 Line Offer.

knowledge.title: Discount plans and line limits
knowledge.content: 55+, Partner and Community plans are sold only to accounts with a matching discount group. 55+ and Saver plans allow at most 2 lines. The Essentials 4 Line Offer needs 4 or more lines. Student accounts have their own discount group for student offers.

knowledge.title: Promotions and conflicts
knowledge.content: Each offer has conditions (new line, port-in, trade-in, specific phone, plan, tenure, lines, credit tier, support contacts). Only one device-attached offer applies per phone at checkout; the most valuable assignment is used. Savings are estimates (a monthly credit counts for 12 months) and are not subtracted from cart totals. Never promise an offer without checking eligibility for that customer and cart.

knowledge.title: Device protection rules
knowledge.content: Protection covers one real phone and its tier must match the phone's tier. A phone cannot be covered twice. The streaming add-on needs an Experience More or Beyond plan; the Beyond connected-device line needs a Beyond plan.

knowledge.title: Why a bill changed
knowledge.content: Bill change reasons in account data: device_installment (a new phone's payment started), installment_ended (a phone is paid off and the bill fell), promo_expired (a discount ended and the bill rose to list price), stable (normal small movement). A bill is plans + protection + add-ons + device installments, minus a $15 Home Internet bundle credit for accounts with both Home Internet and a phone line.

knowledge.title: When to hand off to a person
knowledge.content: Offer a human for: cancellations, switching carriers or port-out requests, billing disputes, fraud, repeated unresolved support contacts, anything the customer is upset about, or when they ask for a person. For at-risk customers prefer a human check-in over a discount.

knowledge.title: Sandbox and honesty rules
knowledge.content: All prices, plans and offers here are synthetic stand-ins for a hackathon, not real T-Mobile offers. Do not state a price, discount or eligibility that is not in this knowledge or the customer's account data. If unsure, say you will check. Orders are mock: nothing is ever charged.

knowledge.content: Customer account facts (lines, devices, bills, support history) are as of 2026-10-01. Quote them with the date. Usage and bills are monthly; support history covers the last 270 days.
